faqs.question: What does the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing test measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects the presence of fungal DNA, and thus, fungal infections, in body fluids by using a combination of molecular biology techniques to identify the DNA of various types of fungi.

faqs.question: Why is the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing test done?
faqs.answer: • To diagnose fungal infections in body fluids. • To guide treatment decisions and monitor the effectiveness of antifungal therapy. • To identify the specific type of fungi causing the infection, which helps determine the appropriate antifungal medications. • To differentiate between fungal infections and other conditions with similar symptoms.

faqs.question: When is the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing test recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test may be recommended if you have • Symptoms suggestive of a fungal infection, such as fever, cough, skin rashes, or abnormal discharge. • A weakened immune system due to conditions such as HIV/AIDS or organ transplantation. • A known exposure to fungi or a high risk of fungal infections due to occupational or environmental factors.

faqs.question: What if the results of the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing test are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate the presence of a fungal infection.

faqs.question: What to expect during the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing test?
faqs.answer: Your healthcare provider will collect a sample of your body fluid, such as blood, cerebrospinal fluid, or pleural fluid. The sample will be sent to the laboratory for analysis.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing test?
faqs.answer: There are no specific preparations required for this test. However, it is essential to provide accurate clinical information and mention the type of body fluid being tested on the Test Request Form (TRF) for proper diagnosis. Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing test?
faqs.answer: Other tests that may be ordered alongside Panfungal-DNA detection include: • Fungal culture: This test helps grow and identify fungi present in a sample. • Antifungal susceptibility testing: It determines which antifungal medications are most effective against the identified fungi. • Histopathology: Microscopic examination of tissue samples to detect fungal elements and evaluate the extent of infection.

faqs.question: What is the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing test also known as?
faqs.answer: This test is also known as Panfungal Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) and Sanger Sequencing.

faqs.question: What is a fungal infection?
faqs.answer: A fungal infection is caused by various types of fungi, which are microscopic organisms commonly found in the environment. Fungal infections can affect different parts of the body, including the skin, nails, lungs, and bloodstream, causing a range of symptoms and complications.
